# Project ABC — Architecture Overview

## Target Architecture

The solution consists of:
- Central Billing Platform
- Customer Account Service
- Product and Pricing Service
- Payment Gateway Integration
- Data Migration Layer
- Reporting and Audit Services

## Data Flow
Customer and product information is received through enterprise interfaces. Billing calculations are performed by the central billing platform. Payment information is integrated through the payment gateway. Billing results are ex

hrough the payment gateway. Billing results are exposed to reporting and audit services.

## Key Technical Concern
The migration layer must preserve billing accuracy and support reconciliation between legacy and target platforms.

## Architecture Principle
The target platform should provide reusable services rather than product-specific billing implementations.

# Project ABC — Project Charter

## Project Information
Project: ABC — Banking Single Billing Transformation
Client: Global Bank
Project Sponsor: Head of Corporate Banking Technology
Project Manager: Rony George
Delivery Model: Agile
Project Start: January 2026
Target Production Release: December 18, 2026

## Objective
Project ABC will consolidate multiple independent billing platforms into a single enterprise billing solution for corporate banking services.

## Business Objectives
- Simplify bi

ng services.

## Business Objectives
- Simplify billing operations.
- Reduce duplicate billing platforms.
- Improve billing transparency.
- Provide consistent customer billing.
- Reduce operational support effort.
- Establish a scalable billing platform for future products.

## Scope
The project includes billing migration, customer billing validation, integration testing, user acceptance testing, production readiness, and migration of in-scope billing products.

## Out of Scope
Changes to unrela

lling products.

## Out of Scope
Changes to unrelated retail banking billing platforms and non-billing customer applications are outside the project scope.

## Success Criteria
- Successful migration of all in-scope billing products.
- UAT completion with no open Severity 1 defects.
- Production readiness approval.
- Successful reconciliation between legacy and target billing.

# Project ABC — Project Overview

The target solution provides common billing capabilities for corporate banking products.

## Current Phase
